name: pm-proxy-orchestrator
description: Fail-closed agent-CLI wrapper for the Firestarter cross-task control plane.

interface.longDescription: Reserves canonical ownership before task creation, carries policy and fence receipts, classifies approvals, records typed handbacks, and recycles blocked work through Firestarter's local authority.
defaultPrompt: Prepare and launch this task through the PM proxy.
Classify this approval through the control plane.
Record this task handback and recycle the queue.
